title: Other answers
html_source: Other answers to Bloom’s ad in the Irish Times for a “smart lady typist,” which started his correspondence with Martha Clifford.

anchor.prefix:
a lark in the Scotch house I bet anything. Round to Menton's office. His oyster eyes staring at the postcard. Be a feast for the gods. 

 He passed the Irish Times. There might be
anchor.suffix: lying there. Like to answer them all. Good system for criminals. Code. At their lunch now. Clerk with the glasses there doesn't know me. O, leave them there to simmer. Enough both
